ELK / elkjs source availability

These materials preserve upstream elkjs 0.12.1's declared ELK 0.12.1 basis,
editable JS/Java/Xtend/GWT sources, original build configuration, declared
runtime sources, notices and exact input/tree hashes. No downstream ELK patches
are required; the old 0.9.1 + PR955 payload is not reused.

ELK/elkjs declare EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later; Brabbler continues under EPL-2.0.
EMF-GWT common/ecore 2.12.4 retains EPL-1.0; Xbase/Xtend 2.36.0 retains EPL-2.0.
GWT 2.13.0 and Guava 31.1-jre retain original Apache/additional notices.

The npm publishing commit is identified and all 12 npm files match that commit.
The external ELK checkout used to compile the worker remains unrecorded by the
publishing workflow. See README.md and MANIFEST.json for full traceability limits.
No independent build, exact compiler-input proof, byte-identical regeneration,
attestation signature verification or legal certification is claimed.

This proposed seed/recipe was not assembled or built during research.
